question: Rani Lakshmibai was defeated and killed in _______ .
solution: The correct answer is __**Jun 1858**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Rani Lakshmibai**, the Queen of Jhansi, was one of the most prominent figures in the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**, which is also referred to as the First War of Indian Independence. • She fought valiantly against the British forces but was ultimately **defeated and killed on 18 June 1858** during the battle at **Gwalior**. • Her death occurred when she attempted to resist the British forces led by General Hugh Rose. **Rani Lakshmibai is remembered for her bravery and patriotism.** • The year **1858** marks the end of the Indian Rebellion, with the British consolidating their power after her demise. • Her life and sacrifice have inspired generations and continue to be celebrated in Indian history as a symbol of resistance against colonial rule.
